issues.title: BLU-001 observation privacy policy — bounded CI evidence

criteria.requirement: Real session restart, sensitive/private window refusal and signed policy approval
criteria.reason: Pure Dart policy tests do not prove real OS permission/capture behavior or provide the required signed privacy review; maintainer must validate physical Mac and approval.

criteria.requirement: Modeled session is off on restart or cancelled and private/unknown windows are refused

tests.name: default-off, restart, revoked consent and cancellation deny
private and sensitive windows deny even with consent
off by default - nothing may observe on a fresh launch
a session never survives a restart - nothing is persisted

criteria.requirement: Deterministic safe-path, missing-consent, missing-allowlist, permission-denial, cancellation and timeout contracts; network-offline not applicable to the pure decision policy

tests.name: explicit safe active session may proceed
start refuses without consent, local-only, or an allowlist
allowlisted app observed only while the session is on
stop cancels in-flight work and drops its result
session expires on its own after the fixed length

criteria.requirement: No unintended egress, secret retention or unsafe capture/execution in the physical macOS implementation
criteria.reason: Hosted unit tests prove modeled deny paths, not the native Screen Recording/TCC pixels or real network behavior. Require recorded hardware/network/privacy evidence and safety review.

criteria.requirement: Simulated observation guards disallow excluded surfaces and no-production-vision egress

tests.name: nothing runs while the session is off
unknown window metadata blocks all frame and event work
sensitive English and Hebrew titles never enter event storage
production watch has no vision callback and no WatchVision
tightened local-only after capture prevents inference

criteria.requirement: Exact-head flutter analyze, acceptance CI links, PR commands and reviewed evidence
criteria.reason: The existing static/test/acceptance-evidence jobs run independently; a maintainer must link exact PR head checks and review issue-level evidence, not infer sign-off from tests alone.
